blocks.html: Manila, Philippines – RLC Residences, the residential arm of Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), has solidified its position as a leading real estate developer in the country by winning the prestigious Developer of the Year awards at both the PropertyGuru Philippines Property Awards 2024 and DOT Property Philippines Awards 2024. These accolades highlight the company’s commitment to delivering high-quality, innovative, and sustainable developments that reshape the residential landscape in the Philippines.
Major wins at the DOT Property Philippines Awards 2024

At the DOT Property Philippines Awards 2024 held last September 12 at Okada Manila, RLC Residences secured six major accolades, including the coveted Developer of the Year award. This recognition highlights the brand's consistent excellence, innovation, and dedication to transforming the residential sector. The company's forward-thinking digital solutions such as the myRLC Home app earned the Special Recognition Award for Innovation.

Several standout RLC Residences projects were recognized. The Residences at The Westin Manila in Ortigas Center won Best Condominium Architectural Design, for its luxury and wellness features. Mantawi Residences in Cebu, the brand’s premium development in Mandaue launched last year, clinched the Best Luxury Development award. SYNC was named Best Smart Home Condominium for its future-ready offerings that address millennials' urban living needs. Meanwhile, Le Pont Residences in Bridgetown Destination Estate received the Best Sustainable Development award, reinforcing RLC Residences' commitment to green practices.

"Winning the Developer of the Year award, along with the other recognitions, is an incredible honor for us at RLC Residences. These awards affirm the hard work and passion of Team RLC Residences as we continue to create spaces that contribute to a better, more sustainable future,” said Chad Sotelo, Senior Vice President and Business Unit General Manager of RLC Residences and Chief Marketing Officer of Robinsons Land.
Success at the PropertyGuru Philippines Property Awards 2024

Robinsons Land and RLC Residences also shone at the PropertyGuru Philippines Property Awards 2024, held on September 6 at Shangri-la The Fort. Robinsons Land won Best Developer – Philippines for the third consecutive year along with Best Developer – Luzon, solidifying its reputation as one of the country's most trusted real estate developers.

RLC Residences’ The Residences at The Westin Manila garnered three prestigious titles: Best Branded Residential Development, Best Wellness Residential Development, and Best Lifestyle Condo Development underscoring the project’s unique blend of luxury, wellness, and convenience.

Other RLC Residences developments were also recognized. Woodsville Crest was highly commended in the Best Condo Development (Luzon) category, while Galleria Residences Cebu and Sierra Valley Gardens were acknowledged for their exceptional designs and smart home features, respectively. RLC Residences also received a Highly Commended award in the Best Lifestyle Developer category and Robinsons Land in the Best Sustainable Developer category, showcasing their shared commitment to eco-friendly practices.

"These recognitions reflect our unwavering commitment to delivering sustainable, innovative homes that cater to the evolving needs of our residents. We are grateful to PropertyGuru and DOT Property for these accolades and look forward to continuing our mission of creating future-ready homes," added Sotelo.

These awards further establish Robinsons Land, along with its residential arm, RLC Residences, as key players in shaping the future of Philippine real estate, with a strong focus on sustainability and meeting the evolving needs of home seekers both locally and internationally.
